title: Breath-interval serial dependence does not establish added cross-cohort forecasting value for next-minute irregularity
abstract: Lag-one breath-interval dependence did not establish added cross-cohort forecasting value for next-minute breath-interval CV beyond current rate, CV and trend. BIDMC-to-CapnoBase record-equal baseline/augmented MSE was 0.01345077/0.01344345, gain 0.00000733 [-0.00005192, 0.00008740]; reverse transfer was 0.01000066/0.01009286, gain -0.00009220 [-0.00025241, 0.00007110]. Both paired target-record bootstrap95% intervals include zero. Current-CV persistence had lower point MSE than either fitted model in both directions. This exploratory result tests a fixed summary and model, not absence of temporal information in breathing.
